pre_fix_evidence.note: The runtime applied the same last-event exchange-age and cross-leg last-update skew gates to uninterrupted WS lineage and REST point-in-time snapshots. REST resync also downgraded a continuous WS lineage whenever that token had no update within 5s.

protocol_basis.market_ws_contract: A full book is sent on subscription; price_change represents order placement/cancellation and book events update the L2 state. Therefore, after a full snapshot and uninterrupted monotone delta lineage, absence of a token update means unchanged state rather than an automatically stale state.
protocol_basis.rest_contract: CLOB /books exposes timestamp+hash for a point-in-time order-book snapshot. REST snapshots remain strictly exchange-age and cross-leg-skew gated.
protocol_basis.transport_rule: Any WS error/reconnect invalidates the affected shard lineage. The research feed idle timeout is shortened from 20s to 5s with keep-alive pings to bound silent socket failure before quiet-book continuity is trusted.

repair.continuous_ws: Do not reject a gap-free WS book solely because the token's last-market-update timestamp is older than 5s or differs from another unchanged WS leg. Keep last-event clocks as audit timestamps.
repair.rest_point_in_time: Retain <=5s exchange-age and <=1.5s cross-leg exchange/receive skew.
repair.mixed_baskets: REST legs satisfy REST age/skew. Continuous WS legs are current by lineage; their old last-update timestamps are not compared to REST snapshot timestamps as if they were snapshot times.
repair.resync: REST polling no longer overwrites an uninterrupted WS lineage merely because that token is quiet.
repair.transport_liveness: The market WebSocket uses keep-alive pings with a 5s idle timeout; reconnect/error invalidates the affected shard lineage before later deltas are trusted.
repair.safety: No real-order path, credential path, sizing authority, drawdown limit, kill switch, or operator directive changed.

post_fix_evidence.note: At steady state all 1,296 tokens had uninterrupted WS full-snapshot lineage; REST point-in-time provenance was no longer needed for current state, cross-leg last-update-skew rejections fell to zero, and every latest hard row was rejected for economics/depth rather than freshness. The residual age counter was accumulated during startup/REST-only phases. Nonhard modeled profit is shadow theory, not PAPER fill-conditioned PnL.

authority_caveat.reason: The current Fast Shadow workflow/policy on this branch is a legacy research surface and is not the authoritative V7 envelope. PR #633 owns that workflow/authority-alignment surface. Therefore hard_executable=0 in this run is not a valid rejection under the authorized 1000-market/$2/0.5bp/non-binding-dollar envelope.

decision: The false freshness blocker from last-update age/skew on quiet continuous WS books is repaired prospectively. No hard opportunity survived the narrower legacy-policy sample. A same-SHA run combining this clock repair with the authoritative V7 breadth/policy is required before judging hard-arb availability; any surviving candidate still requires verified fees, multi-level depth, sequential PAPER legging, partial/unwind accounting, canonical-ledger realized post-cost PnL, and 1x/1.5x/2x stress.
